time.expression: O(M_int(N^{1/4} log N) / sqrt(log log N))

notes: The exact improvement is a sqrt(log log N) factor over the Bostan–Gaudry–Schost bound. The normalized exponent is still 1/4. M_int(k) denotes k-bit integer multiplication cost.
